context.one_line_purpose: AI-powered, offline-first PWA for study tracking, routines, and analytics.

objectives: Deploy current Next.js PWA to Vercel with minimal or zero functional changes.
Preserve offline-first behavior and privacy-by-default posture.
Avoid introducing server/edge compute; keep only CSP report route.
Establish guardrails to prevent regressions (artifact growth, accidental dynamic compute).
assumptions: No SSR/ISR and no global Middleware now or during migration.
AI (Gemini) and Firebase are lazy-loaded and not part of the critical path.
No user authentication and no file uploads for first release.
Vercel default Node 18.x is compatible (no native deps).
constraints: Hobby plan quotas (storage 1 GB, build 45 min, serverless limits).
Minimal changes: no architectural shifts, no new infra.
scope_in: Environment & build configuration for Next.js 15 (App Router).
Minimal policy pages (Privacy & Terms) routed in-app.

process_governance: CI checks for type/lint/tests; basic PR review
security_compliance: Strict CSP; no cookies; no analytics

tasks.title: Create Vercel project and connect repository
tasks.description: Initialize Vercel project, link Git repo, enable preview builds on PRs.

subtasks.title: Create Vercel project
steps: Log in to Vercel and click 'New Project'.
Import Git repository for Study Sentinel.
Select framework = Next.js.

subtasks.title: Configure build settings
steps: Ensure 'Build Command' uses Next.js defaults (`next build`).
Confirm 'Output' auto-detected; standalone output enabled in next.config.js.
Verify Node runtime target is default 18.x (no overrides needed).

subtasks.title: Set environment variables (if any)
steps: Add optional AI keys only if used in server-side contexts (not planned).
Leave Firebase variables unset unless server components require them.

microtasks: Ensure repo CI runs typecheck, lint, tests before deploy.
Restrict team access (if any) to least privilege.
acceptance_criteria: Project created with Git integration and preview deployments enabled.
tasks.rollback_plan: If import fails, retry with minimal settings; temporarily disconnect repo and re-link.

tasks.title: Verify standalone output and artifact size on preview
tasks.description: Confirm production standalone output (~75 MB) is used; ensure build cache size doesn't block builds.

subtasks.title: Trigger preview build
steps: Push a trivial change or open a PR to trigger build.

subtasks.title: Inspect build logs & artifacts
steps: Record build time, artifact size, and any serverless bundles reported.
Verify no function exceeds 250 MB unzipped.
Confirm CSP route is present and tiny (~1.7 KB).

microtasks: Save artifact size metrics into repo docs (docs/deploy-notes.md).
acceptance_criteria: Total artifact ~75 MB; serverless footprint ~2.5 MB; no errors.
tasks.rollback_plan: If artifact balloons, disable optional packs (AI/Firebase) and rebuild; verify tree-shaking.

tasks.title: CSP reporting route verification
tasks.description: Ensure CSP endpoint works and logs are visible in Vercel function logs when violations occur.

subtasks.title: Trigger a benign CSP report
steps: Open preview URL with a dev-only inline script to trigger a report.
Check function logs for the CSP POST.

microtasks: Verify no PII in CSP logs.
acceptance_criteria: CSP route receives and logs violation reports without errors.
tasks.rollback_plan: If failing, validate route path and JSON body parsing; redeploy.

tasks.title: Offline/PWA smoke test on preview
tasks.description: Validate service worker registration, precache, runtime caching, offline shell.

subtasks.title: Install SW and precache
steps: Load preview URL, verify SW installed and caches populated.

subtasks.title: Offline mode test
steps: Toggle offline in DevTools; navigate key routes; ensure content loads from cache/IndexedDB.

microtasks: Confirm outbox queues and replays on reconnect.
acceptance_criteria: Offline read/write works; no console errors; caches respect strategy tiers.
tasks.rollback_plan: If offline fails, check Workbox routes and scope settings; rebuild.

tasks.title: Minimal policy pages (Privacy & Terms)
tasks.description: Add minimal, truthful policy pages describing local-first storage, no analytics, export/import, and backup guidance.

subtasks.title: Create /privacy and /terms routes
steps: Add static pages with plain content; link from app footer or settings.

microtasks: Confirm no cookies used; reflect in policy.
Mention optional AI usage and local caching behaviors.
acceptance_criteria: Pages load and accurately reflect current behavior; linked in UI.
tasks.rollback_plan: Revert pages if incorrect; update copy and redeploy.

tasks.title: Production deployment
tasks.description: Promote preview to production on Vercel subdomain.

subtasks.title: Deploy to production
steps: Click 'Promote to Production' on the verified preview build.

subtasks.title: Post-deploy checks
steps: Run PWA smoke tests on production URL.
Check CSP route and logs again.

microtasks: Capture production URL and share internally.
Confirm no accidental Middleware was introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Production site reachable; offline works; CSP OK; no regressions.
tasks.rollback_plan: Use Vercel 'Rollback' to previous production deployment.

tasks.title: Optional (post-launch): SW update UX prompt
tasks.description: Replace auto-activation with user-prompted update to avoid mid-session disruptions.

subtasks.title: Implement update prompt
steps: Detect waiting SW, show banner; postpone activation until user confirms or timers complete.

subtasks.title: Multi-tab coordination
steps: Use BroadcastChannel to coordinate refresh across tabs.

microtasks: Unit test cache eviction caps for each tier.
acceptance_criteria: No mid-session restarts; user sees clear update prompt; caches remain bounded.
tasks.rollback_plan: Re-enable auto-activation if prompt causes issues.

automations.title: Monthly usage snapshot
automations.message: Record Vercel Usage (Data Transfer, Edge Requests, Functions, Active CPU) and compare to 60/80/90% thresholds.

acceptance_criteria_overall: Production deployed on Vercel subdomain with artifact ~75 MB.
Offline-first behavior verified (reads/writes) and CSP reporting operational.
Zero global Middleware; no SSR/ISR; AI/Firebase remain lazy-loaded.

risk_register.mitigation: CI bundle budgets; monthly usage snapshot
No new server routes without review; keep AI client-only
